_comment: Website content that lives independently of the toolkit code. Currently drives the 'Also worth installing' tile grid on /toolkit/. To add a tile: append an entry to recommendedTools and commit - the site fetches this file from jsDelivr and re-renders. Category maps to badge color: branded=green, diagnostics=amber, productivity=blue, customization=purple, builtin=blue.

recommendedTools.name: iDezign Help (TeamViewer)
recommendedTools.description: Pre-branded remote-support download - runs as 'iDezign Help', not vanilla TeamViewer. The one you call me about.

recommendedTools.name: Advanced IP Scanner
recommendedTools.description: Free LAN scanner. See every device on your network - IP, MAC, hostname, remote-in to PCs. Indispensable for network triage.

recommendedTools.name: Ninite
recommendedTools.description: Batch-install common freeware in one click - Chrome, VLC, 7-Zip, Notepad++, Zoom, etc. No bundled toolbars or junk.

recommendedTools.name: Brave Browser
recommendedTools.description: Chromium-based browser with ad and tracker blocking built in. Faster pages, fewer popups, no extension juggling.

recommendedTools.name: Google Drive for Desktop
recommendedTools.description: Sync Drive to a folder on your PC. Open, edit, save Drive files like local files - no browser tab required.

recommendedTools.name: Open-Shell
recommendedTools.description: Classic Start menu for Windows 10 and 11. Bring back the simple, fast menu - full customization, no telemetry.

recommendedTools.name: Windows Update
recommendedTools.description: Opens Settings > Windows Update on this PC. Click 'Check for updates' from there. Keep Windows patched - most 'my computer is slow / weird' calls trace back to a missing update.

recommendedTools.name: Dell Command | Update
recommendedTools.description: Dell's own driver + BIOS updater for Dell hardware. What Diagnostics tries to install (via winget) and scan with. Install manually here if winget isn't available on the machine.

recommendedTools.name: Intel Driver & Support Assistant
recommendedTools.description: Intel's driver checker for Intel CPU/GPU/NIC/WiFi/Bluetooth. Diagnostics points you here when it detects Intel silicon without DSA installed - grab it to keep chipset drivers current.

recommendedTools.name: HP Support Assistant
recommendedTools.description: HP's driver + firmware + diagnostics utility for HP hardware. Cleanup auto-installs it on HP machines. Grab it manually here if you're on HP but winget isn't available.

recommendedTools.name: Lenovo Vantage
recommendedTools.description: Lenovo's system control panel - drivers, warranty, battery health, hardware tuning. Cleanup auto-installs it from the Microsoft Store on Lenovo machines.
